mapper.select: select behr.id as billHandleRecordId, DATE_FORMAT(behr.crt_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as handleDate, behr.org_id as orgId, behr.crt_id as operatorId, behr.crt_name as operatorName, behr.operate_type as operateType from bill_exception_handle_record behr where behr.treatment_record_id = #{treatmentRecordId} order by behr.id desc
select behr.id from bill_exception_handle_record behr where behr.pre_exception_handle_record_id = #{id}
SELECT ifNull(behr.id, 0) as id FROM bill_exception_handle_record behr WHERE behr.handled_record_id = #{handledRecordId} AND behr.operate_type = #{operateType} ORDER BY behr.crt_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT bar.billExceptionHandleRecordId, DATE_FORMAT(bar.crt_time, '%Y-%m-%d') adjustDate, bar.orderDate, bar.billNum, bar.patientId, bar.regDentistId, bar.adjustOperatorId FROM ( SELECT behr.id AS billExceptionHandleRecordId, behdr.orgId, behr.crt_time, behdr.orderDate AS orderDate, behdr.billNumber AS billNum, behdr.patientId patientId, tr.dentist_id AS regDentistId, behr.crt_id AS adjustOperatorId, behdr.billDate FROM ( SELECT id, treatment_record_id, crt_id, crt_time FROM bill_exception_handle_record WHERE operate_type = 2 ) behr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT behdr.bill_handle_record_id AS billExceptionhandleRecordId, br.patient_id AS patientId, br.org_id as orgId, br.bill_number AS billNumber, DATE_FORMAT( br.crt_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS billDate, DATE_FORMAT( ord.crt_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS orderDate FROM bill_exception_handle_detail_record behdr LEFT JOIN bill_record br ON behdr.associate_record_id = br.order_record_id LEFT JOIN order_record ord ON behdr.associate_record_id = ord.id ) behdr ON behr.id = behdr.billExceptionhandleRecordId LEFT JOIN treatment_record tr ON behr.treatment_record_id = tr.id ) bar
and bar.orgId = #{query.orgId}
and bar.billNum like concat('%', #{query.billNum}, '%')
and DATE_FORMAT(bar.crt_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{query.adjustStartDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
and DATE_FORMAT(bar.crt_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{query.adjustEndDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
and DATE_FORMAT(bar.billDate,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{query.billStartDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
and DATE_FORMAT(bar.billDate,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{query.billEndDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
and bar.regDentistId in
#{item}
ORDER BY bar.crt_time DESC
